name: Ziad Hares
title: Chief Technology Officer, Begad · Founder, Computator Technology
headline: CTO at Begad · founder of Computator Technology · cybersecurity & systems engineer
hero_subtitle: BSc Cybersecurity (UOWD) · graduating Dec 2026 · Dubai, UAE. Running production e-commerce, hardened infrastructure and local-first AI for UAE clients. Open to security engineering roles and consulting engagements.
summary: Chief Technology Officer of Begad, a bilingual UAE marketplace (begad.ae), and founder of Computator Technology, a Dubai-licensed software and managed-IT firm. Accountable for Begad's platform, payments, cloud, mobile apps and security: closed revenue leaks in checkout, restored production after a total loss with no backups, and run an ISO/IEC 27001-aligned security programme. Security-first engineer with a penetration-testing background; final-year BSc Cybersecurity at UOWD (Dec 2026) and founder and head of cybersecurity at the UOWD Tech Club.
about: CTO at Begad, a bilingual UAE marketplace, and founder of Computator Technology, while finishing a BSc in Cybersecurity. Since August 2026 I have run Begad's technology end to end, from payments and mobile apps to its ISO/IEC 27001-aligned security programme.

Through Computator I build systems for clients such as BHF Auctions and Mon Maison. At university I founded and lead the Tech Club's cybersecurity team, and at home I run a Proxmox pentest range and a self-hosted secure communications stack. I care about systems that are secure by construction and documented well enough to rebuild.

bullets: Own technology end to end for a bilingual UAE marketplace (PHP 8.3, MariaDB, AWS): platform, payments, mobile apps, analytics and security, with 2,400+ production commits.

Run the ISO/IEC 27001-aligned security programme: least-privilege portals, signed Stripe webhooks, versioned migrations, tested backups, SPF/DKIM/DMARC and audit logging; closed a security and money audit (Nov 2026).
Closed revenue leaks by confirming orders only after Stripe capture; added Apple/Google Pay and Tabby BNPL, and held seller payouts until the return window closes.
Rebuilt ad attribution from zero events to full-funnel Meta and TikTok server-side tracking, and cut UAE latency with CloudFront edge caching.
Recovered the platform from git after production was deleted with no backups (Aug 2026), then added CI/CD, automated backups and runbooks.
Shipped iOS/Android apps, a public agent API with MCP tools, Begad Food (food.begad.ae), vidvie.ae, and automated seller pickups and driver logistics.
Run a Dubai DET-licensed sole establishment delivering custom software, data platforms, websites and managed IT to UAE and Libyan clients; engineering partner to Begad.
Engineered an automated invoicing and billing engine supporting multi-account routing (Ziina integration) and programmatic PDF export.
